description: Test suite for the OpenClaw project, specifically testing SessionData models and associated logic in Swift.

classes.name: SessionDataTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for SessionKind, SessionTokenStats, and SessionRow functionalities.

methods.name: session kind from key detects common kinds
methods.description: Tests whether SessionKind correctly identifies session types from string keys.

methods.name: session token stats format K tokens rounds as expected
methods.description: Verifies formatting of token counts into human-readable strings.

methods.name: session token stats percent used clamps to100
methods.description: Checks that the percent used calculation caps at 100%.

methods.name: session row flag labels include non default flags
methods.description: Ensures that flag labels for a session row include non-default flags such as 'think high', 'verbose debug', etc.
